method.acoustic: Same-context canonical intended and wrong homophone references; shared-standardized MFCC/delta plus Praat centered F0, full-passage DTW mapped to the target syllable. Canonical self-tests are retained by evidence SHA.
method.content_match: Actual mixed film audio vs cached correct production TTS; exact normalized overlap waveform correlation with FFT cross-correlation and cumulative-square normalization. No new synthesis.
method.tail_asr: Only last narrated segment plus brand outro; local multilingual base model on actual PCM array. File-path decode previously rejected metadata_errors; PCM avoids that library incompatibility. ASR does not establish tone.
